comparison.objective: Candidate extracts a terminal; record caps and color-sorts four pens.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses a thin blade under a recessed locking tab while pulling a wire; record aligns hollow caps to pen barrels, inserts them, and sorts completed pens.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires selective removal without damage; record requires four matching caps retained and four released pens resting in designated areas.
comparison.reason: Generic insertion and bimanual handling are shared, but the tested mechanisms and outcomes differ.
